text:
Nina: Landing in Paddington at 10:50, meeting at 12:30. Need a quick brunch spot within 8-10 mins walk. Prefer something with seats and a decent coffee. Ideas? :coffee:
Tom: Wellington Bakery (10 min) 10/10 croissants, sourdough toasties, tiny but seats. Fast service. :croissant:
Esha: Mrs Buckley9s on Praed St is proper Full English, but slow on weekends. Good if you want sit-down and cosy. :bacon:
Sam: For speed+veg, try GreenCrate cafe next to the station 10 min, grab-and-go salads and shakshuka, always quick. :leafy_green:
Nina: Hmm I7m vegetarian today. Any recs for a hot veg brunch?
Esha: GreenCrate has a wicked halloumi wrap and hot porridge. Also they do express orders via app.
Tom: If you want indulgent + fast, Wellington does a toasted halloumi & tomato on sourdough that7s ready quick.
DevOpsBot: Heads-up: Paddington roadworks on Praed St between 09:00-14:00 causing minor delays. Allow +3 minutes walking. Link: https://status.city/paddington-roadworks
Nina: Ugh roadworks. Ok leaning GreenCrate then. Sam you mentioned seats?
Sam: They have 6 stools and two small tables. If you need proper table, Mrs Buckley7s but add 10-15 min.
Tom: Pro tip: order ahead at Wellington via their counter app and choose "ready in 5". Saved me during last week's train. :thumbsup:
Esha: Also FYI Wellington takes card only, no cash. GreenCrate has contactless and Apple Pay.
Nina: Thanks all. Going GreenCrate, ordering now. Will DM ETA. :v:
